composer.multiline_rule: Live: a SETTLED draft with any text is multi-line (text on its own row, + and tools on a second row, height 102) — every screenshot with text showed it, even 'Hi'; WHILE characters were being typed the DOM still reported single-line until the text was wider than the 520 px field. Kit default = single-line (the typing look, stable for motion); set layout_class 'is-multiline' for the settled look (once typing stops, or at once when the prompt is wider than multiline_over_px). A pill or attachment in the draft always switches to multi-line by itself (CSS :has).

Content shown: the placeholder, test prompts I typed (a glass bottle on a beach), Jake's own earlier test prompts ('Make the aspect ratio 16:9', a generic logo-brief prompt), generated apple images, a synthetic gradient test image and a test 'brief.txt'
private_check.actions: nothing was sent, deleted, renamed or shared; Enter was blocked in the driver; the click guard (clickguard.mjs) was on for every click. Two neutral test attachments (beach-reference.png = a canvas gradient, brief.txt = one sentence) were placed in the draft of the throwaway profile COPY to capture the chip styles; the guard refuses 'Remove', so they stayed in that copy's draft, which was deleted (they were uploaded to ChatGPT as draft files but never sent)
